description: This file defines a 'javascript' class responsible for generating JavaScript validation scripts for form handling in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods to add validation rules for form fields, manage required fields, and produce the final script to be embedded in web pages for client-side validation.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: Class for constructing JavaScript validation scripts for form validation in a CRM system.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the name of the form to be validated.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class, setting a default sugarbean object.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Assigns a sugarbean object containing field definitions.

methods.name: addRequiredFields
methods.description: Adds validation rules for all required fields of the sugarbean.

methods.name: addSpecialField
methods.description: Adds validation for a specific field, such as date validation.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds validation rules for a specific form field, considering its properties.

methods.name: stripEndColon
methods.description: Removes trailing colons or colon-space from a string.

methods.name: addFieldGeneric
methods.description: Generates JavaScript validation code for a generic field.

methods.name: addFieldCallback
methods.description: Adds validation rule for a callback-based validation.

methods.name: addFieldRange
methods.description: Adds validation for numeric ranges.

methods.name: addFieldIsValidDate
methods.description: Adds validation to check if a field contains a valid date.

methods.name: addFieldIsValidTime
methods.description: Adds validation to check if a field contains a valid time.

methods.name: addFieldDateBefore
methods.description: Adds validation to ensure a date is before another date.

methods.name: addFieldDateBeforeAllowBlank
methods.description: Adds validation for date before another, allowing blank input.

methods.name: addToValidateBinaryDependency
methods.description: Adds validation for binary dependency between fields.

methods.name: addToValidateComparison
methods.description: Adds validation for comparison between fields.

methods.name: addFieldIsInArray
methods.description: Validates if a field's value is within a specified array.

methods.name: addAllFields
methods.description: Adds validation for all fields of the sugarbean object, with options to skip certain fields or translate labels.

methods.name: addActionMenu
methods.description: Adds JavaScript code to initialize action menu on document ready.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Returns the assembled JavaScript validation script, optionally wrapped in script tags.

methods.name: buildStringToTranslateInSmarty
methods.description: Creates a translatable string block for inclusion in Smarty templates.

methods.name: getRequiredString
methods.description: Returns 'true' or 'false' string based on field requirement.
